basis: Measured with scripts/video_audit.py on five reference Roblox story reels (guides/) and the studio's own films, Nov 2026. Reference reels: 13-41 cuts/min, median shot 1.3-4.2 s, mean motion 3.6-10.6, zero frozen seconds. Studio films before this bar: 10-26 cuts/min, mean motion 0.6-2.9, Falling Up froze for 22 s.

scene.note: Scene audit errors are collisions, hidden faces, camera inside geometry, frozen actors and one-scale films. Warnings need a written disposition in the review note.
